correctness.rationale: Unrolling the first EMA for (-1)^(t-1)G gives mhat_t/g_t = (1-beta1)/(1+beta1) * [1-(-beta1)^t]/[1-beta1^t]. It equals a on every even step and a(1+beta1^t)/(1-beta1^t) on odd steps. Constant g_t^2 forces v_t=G^2(1-beta2^t) and vhat_t=G^2. Thus the denominator is |G|+epsilon independent of nu2,beta2. Differentiation yields d q_inf/d beta1=-2nu1/(1+beta1)^2, which is zero at nu1=0 and strictly negative only if nu1>0. The source RESULT.md wrongly said strictly decreasing for all fixed nu1, contradicting its own derivative. The full replacement RESULT.md corrects this boundary while retaining and proving the Nyquist response and sharp floor. Independent recurrence/limit checks corroborate but do not establish the analytic proof.
